## TemplateEngine.validateBlockGInlineButtonAttributes() method

Validates attributes on `<g-inline-button>` blocks.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static validateBlockGInlineButtonAttributes(template: string): {
        valid: boolean;
        errors: Array<{
            line: number;
            message: string;
        }>;
    };
```

An object with a `valid` boolean and an `errors` array

## Remarks

Allowed attributes are `lang`<!-- -->, `text`<!-- -->, and `start-parameter`<!-- -->. `text` is required and must be non-empty; a static `start-parameter` must match the Bot API deep-link format (`[A-Za-z0-9_-]`<!-- -->, at most 64 chars) while `{{}}` / `{~ ~}` spans skip the static check (runtime-enforced, mirroring the `_validateDiceItems` static/dynamic split).

## Example


```typescript
const result = TemplateEngine.validateBlockGInlineButtonAttributes(`<g-base><g-inline-button text="Lihat" start-parameter="d-1"/></g-base>`);
// Result: { valid: true, errors: [] }
```
